bait_content.title: Profile Storage Lock Detected
bait_content.body: Chrome detected an unclean shutdown (Event ID: CHR-PROFILE-4096). The profile’s storage is locked and the cache is running in read-only mode. Sync, extensions, and checkout forms may be limited until a quick integrity check clears the lock and reindexes cache files. This operation will restart background services but will not delete your data.
